games.notes: Pippen and Stewart out for Memphis; Barnes and Quickley questionable for Toronto. Two young, fun teams with a real shot at a close, entertaining game.
Harris out and Vassell questionable for San Antonio, Goodwin questionable for Phoenix. Wemby and the Spurs should handle a bad Suns team, likely not close.
Jokic, Murray, Gordon, DeRozan questionable for Denver; Capela out for Houston. If Jokic plays it is a real test for the Rockets, if not a lopsided night.
Luka sat Sunday with back tightness and tonight's status is unconfirmed. Lakers on a back-to-back, Hawks missing Newell and Landale; fun only if Luka plays.
Duren out for Detroit; Anthony Davis questionable for Washington. Cade and the Pistons on a back-to-back but should still win, likely a comfortable one.
Haliburton out and McConnell questionable for Indiana; Lively out for Dallas. Flagg's Mavs on a back-to-back but still the better team, so skip unless you like Flagg.
Butler and Porzingis out for Golden State; Missi out for New Orleans on a back-to-back. Curry is the only reason to watch, likely a Warriors win.
Knueppel, Miller and Schroder out for Charlotte; Merrill and Tyson out, Allen questionable for Cleveland. Two middling teams, likely a Cavs win, skip.
